sermon.title: What the Holy Spirit Requires and Promises
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches what the Holy Spirit requires—Bible morals in leaders, God’s pattern for church services, courage to expose sin, and repentance to keep the Spirit—and what he promises: the Spirit on the Messiah, the Spirit within us causing obedience, graves opened, dreams and visions, and a latter-day glorious church before Christ’s single return.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: One phrase at 32:50 was not clear. Caption fixes include Joash, Jehoiada, Zechariah, Jon Stewart and Bill Maher, Haggai. He cites Nehemiah 9:29 (9:30), 2 Peter 1:19 (1:21) and again 1 Timothy 1:5 (1:15). Points to check: rehab “seven percent success rate”; that Joseph’s mummified body was in a grave near Jerusalem and came out when Jesus rose (Joseph was buried at Shechem, Joshua 24:32; Matthew 27 names no one); four revivals, the last 1948–1980s. Sensitive content kept as spoken: alcohol, evolution and homosexuality in schools, Muslims/Hindus, abortion compared with beheadings, Mexico conquering America, Mother Teresa, Jesus never giving alms, no pre-tribulation rapture, “now it’s 2016.”

faqs.question: Does the Bible permit drinking?
faqs.answer: He says Christians twist scripture to permit it, and drinking opens you to immoral behavior and lowers your standards.

faqs.question: Who are the sons of God?
faqs.answer: Those led by the Spirit of God from the time they get up until they go to bed.

faqs.question: Should we lean on a minister?
Is the Bible myths written by men?
faqs.answer: No—it was written by the Holy Ghost through men.

faqs.question: Is feeling God’s presence the same as having the Holy Spirit?
faqs.answer: He says no—the corporate presence differs from the Spirit’s individual, active expression to you.

faqs.question: Did the apostles waver after being filled?
faqs.answer: No—no nervous breakdowns or affairs; the Holy Ghost empowered them.

faqs.question: Is Jesus discouraged when we mess up?
faqs.answer: No—he knows the power of his blood, word and Spirit to finish the work he began.

faqs.question: Is numerology valid?
faqs.answer: He says get rid of numerology; there’s no such thing and it has destroyed many people.

faqs.question: Is the pre-tribulation rapture biblical?
faqs.answer: He says no—the Bible says Jesus is coming once, not twice.
